Note: All measures are weighted by the individual survey weight. AUC: weighted area under the ROC curve (ties counted as one half). Calibration slope: coefficient of the logit of the predicted probability in a weighted logistic regression; calibration intercept: intercept with the logit as an offset; observed/expected: weighted observed over weighted mean predicted positives.

Note: The PHQ-2 score is a symptom-based comparator sharing two items with the PHQ-8; it is not an upper bound, and calibration is not defined for it. 95% CI: household cluster bootstrap (2,000 replicates), conditional on the fixed model fits.
